description_one_sentence: The master list of ShopFast customers with their contact details, address, birth date, marketing consent and loyalty tier.
issues_spotted: 8 duplicate customer_id; 48 empty + 19 invalid + 41 duplicate emails; country written 11 ways (FR/France/FRA/...); loyalty_tier inconsistent case + 'Platinium' typo; 174 unparseable birth_date, 5 in the future; 37 empty country

description_one_sentence: The catalogue of products ShopFast sells, with price, category, supplier and whether the product is still active.
issues_spotted: 1 duplicate SKU; 1 product with a missing/non-positive price; category values inconsistent (Sports vs SPORTS, Electronics vs electronics)

description_one_sentence: Every order placed by customers, with its date, status, sales channel, destination country and total amount.
issues_spotted: 7 duplicate order_id; 14 orders reference a customer_id that does not exist; status inconsistent (shipped/SHIPPED, cancelled/canceled, delivered/Delivered); 6 totals <= 0; 11 unparseable and 5 future order_date

description_one_sentence: The individual product lines inside each order, with quantity and unit price.
issues_spotted: 8 lines with quantity <= 0; 4 lines reference a product_id missing from the catalogue (orphan foreign key)

description_one_sentence: The payments received for orders, with the method, amount, currency and the last 4 digits of the card.
issues_spotted: 1953 of 4902 rows (~40%) have an empty card_last4; card_last4 retained even for non-card methods (paypal/apple_pay/bank_transfer) - data-minimisation concern; status limited to captured/refunded (no 'failed')

description_one_sentence: Customer-service tickets with the customer's question and the agent's notes, written in free text.
issues_spotted: Free-text fields leak personal data: 26 full 16-digit card numbers, 73 email addresses and ~19 phone numbers pasted into message/agent_notes; per the rule one card number in free text makes the whole table Restricted

description_one_sentence: A one-off export of customers (name, email, loyalty tier) built to target a marketing campaign.
issues_spotted: 29 recipients have no matching customer / no recorded consent (possible emailing without consent - GDPR issue); it is a shadow copy of personal data (name + email) kept outside the governed customers table
